# Recipes whose JSON deliberately differs from the reference capture.
#
# The port's contract is that a hosted upstream recipe encodes exactly as the
# Scala does. Anything recorded here breaks that byte-identity on purpose, so a
# difference is auditable rather than invisible.
#
# Every field of every recipe that is *not* listed here still has to match that
# capture byte for byte, and the test fails if an entry stops being needed, so
# the list cannot quietly rot.
#
# Format: <ObjectName> <field>[,<field>...]  # why
# Fields are the top-level JSON keys of the recipe response.

BeetrootRisotto notes  # markdown link; plus a local chaos note the upstream recipe has no equivalent of
MeltyMushroomWellingtons ingredients_blocks,method  # spinach amount and bake time corrected locally, with a note saying so
RoastBeetrootDahl notes  # markdown link
